title: SpaceX will build a second, $100B 'Starbase' spaceport in Louisiana | TechCrunch
summary: The new launch site will sit along the Gulf Coast in Vermilion Parish, west of New Orleans and roughly 10 hours from the company’s existing Starbase complex in South Texas.
